scenarios.finalMessagePreview:
Saved the complete sourced answer, record IDs, and pagination log to [answer.md](answer.md).

Alabama HB591, 2026 Regular Session, returned **five recorded floor-vote entries**:

| 2026-04-01 | HBIR: Passed by House of Origin | 104 | 0 | 1 | 0 |

scenarios.finalMessagePreview:
Rex Reynolds’s latest recorded date is **May 8, 2026**, with one vote:

| Bill / session | Motion | Position | Roll-call tally |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SB1 / 2026 1st Special Session | Lee motion to Previous Question — Roll Call 3 | **YEA** | 75 yea, 29 nay, 1 absent, 0 not voting |

Using `limit=1` and `latest=false`, I followed `next_cursor` to the next page, which returned May 6—confirming the latest date was exhausted. No intra-day order is inferred.
